mapper.select: SELECT SUM(STORE_COUNT) AS storeCount, SUM(OPENING_STORE_COUNT) AS openingStoreCount, SUM(CLOSURE_STORE_COUNT) AS closureStoreCount, SUM(FRANCHISE_STORE_COUNT) AS franchiseStoreCount FROM STORE WHERE ADMIN_DONG_CODE = #{adminDongCode} AND SERVICE_INDUSTRY_CODE = #{serviceIndustryCode} AND BASE_YEAR_QUARTER_CODE = #{yearQuarter} - 10

SELECT S.ADMIN_DONG_CODE AS adminDongCode, SUM(S.STORE_COUNT) AS storeCount FROM STORE S WHERE LEFT(CAST(S.ADMIN_DONG_CODE AS CHAR), 5) = LEFT(CAST(#{adminDongCode} AS CHAR), 5) AND S.SERVICE_INDUSTRY_CODE = #{serviceIndustryCode} AND S.BASE_YEAR_QUARTER_CODE = #{yearQuarter} GROUP BY S.ADMIN_DONG_CODE

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN MC.MAIN_CATEGORY_NAME = '외식업' THEN S.STORE_COUNT ELSE 0 END) AS foodCount, SUM(CASE WHEN MC.MAIN_CATEGORY_NAME = '서비스업' THEN S.STORE_COUNT ELSE 0 END) AS serviceCount, SUM(CASE WHEN MC.MAIN_CATEGORY_NAME = '소매업' THEN S.STORE_COUNT ELSE 0 END) AS retailCount FROM STORE S JOIN SERVICE_CATEGORY SC ON S.SERVICE_INDUSTRY_CODE = SC.SERVICE_CATEGORY_CODE JOIN MAIN_CATEGORY MC ON SC.MAIN_CATEGORY_CODE = MC.MAIN_CATEGORY_CODE WHERE S.ADMIN_DONG_CODE = #{adminDongCode} AND S.BASE_YEAR_QUARTER_CODE = #{yearQuarter}

SELECT TOTAL_FLOATING_POPULATION AS totalFloatingPopulation, MALE_FLOATING_POPULATION AS maleFloatingPopulation, FEMALE_FLOATING_POPULATION AS femaleFloatingPopulation, AGE_10_FLOATING_POPULATION AS age10FloatingPopulation, AGE_20_FLOATING_POPULATION AS age20FloatingPopulation, AGE_30_FLOATING_POPULATION AS age30FloatingPopulation, AGE_40_FLOATING_POPULATION AS age40FloatingPopulation, AGE_50_FLOATING_POPULATION AS age50FloatingPopulation, AGE_60_ABOVE_FLOATING_POPULATION AS age60AboveFloatingPopulation, TIME_00_06_FLOATING_POPULATION AS time0006FloatingPopulation, TIME_06_11_FLOATING_POPULATION AS time0611FloatingPopulation, TIME_11_14_FLOATING_POPULATION AS time1114FloatingPopulation, TIME_14_17_FLOATING_POPULATION AS time1417FloatingPopulation, TIME_17_21_FLOATING_POPULATION AS time1721FloatingPopulation, TIME_21_24_FLOATING_POPULATION AS time2124FloatingPopulation, MONDAY_FLOATING_POPULATION AS mondayFloatingPopulation, TUESDAY_FLOATING_POPULATION AS tuesdayFloatingPopulation, WEDNESDAY_FLOATING_POPULATION AS wednesdayFloatingPopulation, THURSDAY_FLOATING_POPULATION AS thursdayFloatingPopulation, FRIDAY_FLOATING_POPULATION AS fridayFloatingPopulation, SATURDAY_FLOATING_POPULATION AS saturdayFloatingPopulation, SUNDAY_FLOATING_POPULATION AS sundayFloatingPopulation FROM STREET_POPULATION WHERE ADMIN_DONG_CODE = #{adminDongCode} AND BASE_YEAR_QUARTER_CODE = #{yearQuarter}
SELECT TOTAL_FLOATING_POPULATION AS totalFloatingPopulation FROM STREET_POPULATION WHERE ADMIN_DONG_CODE = #{adminDongCode} AND BASE_YEAR_QUARTER_CODE = #{yearQuarter} - 10

SELECT SP.ADMIN_DONG_CODE AS adminDongCode, SP.TOTAL_FLOATING_POPULATION AS totalFloatingPopulation FROM STREET_POPULATION SP WHERE LEFT(CAST(SP.ADMIN_DONG_CODE AS CHAR), 5) = LEFT(CAST(#{adminDongCode} AS CHAR), 5) AND SP.BASE_YEAR_QUARTER_CODE = #{yearQuarter}

SELECT TOTAL_RESIDENT_POPULATION AS totalResidentPopulation, MALE_RESIDENT_POPULATION AS maleResidentPopulation, FEMALE_RESIDENT_POPULATION AS femaleResidentPopulation, MALE_AGE_10_RESIDENT_POPULATION AS maleAge10ResidentPopulation, MALE_AGE_20_RESIDENT_POPULATION AS maleAge20ResidentPopulation, MALE_AGE_30_RESIDENT_POPULATION AS maleAge30ResidentPopulation, MALE_AGE_40_RESIDENT_POPULATION AS maleAge40ResidentPopulation, MALE_AGE_50_RESIDENT_POPULATION AS maleAge50ResidentPopulation, MALE_AGE_60_ABOVE_RESIDENT_POPULATION AS maleAge60AboveResidentPopulation, FEMALE_AGE_10_RESIDENT_POPULATION AS femaleAge10ResidentPopulation, FEMALE_AGE_20_RESIDENT_POPULATION AS femaleAge20ResidentPopulation, FEMALE_AGE_30_RESIDENT_POPULATION AS femaleAge30ResidentPopulation, FEMALE_AGE_40_RESIDENT_POPULATION AS femaleAge40ResidentPopulation, FEMALE_AGE_50_RESIDENT_POPULATION AS femaleAge50ResidentPopulation, FEMALE_AGE_60_ABOVE_RESIDENT_POPULATION AS femaleAge60AboveResidentPopulation, TOTAL_HOUSEHOLD_COUNT AS totalHouseholdCount, APARTMENT_HOUSEHOLD_COUNT AS apartmentHouseholdCount, NON_APARTMENT_HOUSEHOLD_COUNT AS nonApartmentHouseholdCount FROM RESIDENT_POPULATION WHERE ADMIN_DONG_CODE = #{adminDongCode} AND BASE_YEAR_QUARTER_CODE = #{yearQuarter}

SELECT TOTAL_RESIDENT_POPULATION AS totalResidentPopulation, TOTAL_HOUSEHOLD_COUNT AS totalHouseholdCount FROM RESIDENT_POPULATION WHERE ADMIN_DONG_CODE = #{adminDongCode} AND BASE_YEAR_QUARTER_CODE = #{yearQuarter} - 10

SELECT TOTAL_RESIDENT_POPULATION AS totalResidentPopulation, TOTAL_HOUSEHOLD_COUNT AS totalHouseholdCount FROM RESIDENT_POPULATION WHERE ADMIN_DONG_CODE = #{adminDongCode} AND BASE_YEAR_QUARTER_CODE = #{yearQuarter} - 10

SELECT APARTMENT_COMPLEX_COUNT AS apartmentComplexCount, APT_AREA_UNDER_66SQM_UNIT_COUNT AS aptAreaUnder66SqmUnitCount, APT_AREA_66SQM_UNIT_COUNT AS aptArea66SqmUnitCount, APT_AREA_99SQM_UNIT_COUNT AS aptArea99SqmUnitCount, APT_AREA_132SQM_UNIT_COUNT AS aptArea132SqmUnitCount, APT_AREA_165SQM_UNIT_COUNT AS aptArea165SqmUnitCount, APT_PRICE_UNDER_100M_UNIT_COUNT AS aptPriceUnder100mUnitCount, APT_PRICE_100M_UNIT_COUNT AS aptPrice100mUnitCount, APT_PRICE_200M_UNIT_COUNT AS aptPrice200mUnitCount, APT_PRICE_300M_UNIT_COUNT AS aptPrice300mUnitCount, APT_PRICE_400M_UNIT_COUNT AS aptPrice400mUnitCount, APT_PRICE_500M_UNIT_COUNT AS aptPrice500mUnitCount, APT_PRICE_600M_ABOVE_UNIT_COUNT AS aptPrice600mAboveUnitCount, APARTMENT_AVG_AREA AS apartmentAvgArea, APARTMENT_AVG_PRICE AS apartmentAvgPrice FROM APARTMENT WHERE ADMIN_DONG_CODE = #{adminDongCode} AND BASE_YEAR_QUARTER_CODE = #{yearQuarter}

SELECT TOTAL_VISITOR_FACILITY_COUNT AS totalVisitorFacilityCount, GOVERNMENT_OFFICE_COUNT AS governmentOfficeCount, BANK_COUNT AS bankCount, GENERAL_HOSPITAL_COUNT AS generalHospitalCount, HOSPITAL_COUNT AS hospitalCount, PHARMACY_COUNT AS pharmacyCount, KINDERGARTEN_COUNT AS kindergartenCount, ELEMENTARY_SCHOOL_COUNT AS elementarySchoolCount, MIDDLE_SCHOOL_COUNT AS middleSchoolCount, HIGH_SCHOOL_COUNT AS highSchoolCount, UNIVERSITY_COUNT AS universityCount, DEPARTMENT_STORE_COUNT AS departmentStoreCount, SUPERMARKET_COUNT AS supermarketCount, THEATER_COUNT AS theaterCount, ACCOMMODATION_COUNT AS accommodationCount, AIRPORT_COUNT AS airportCount, RAILWAY_STATION_COUNT AS railwayStationCount, BUS_TERMINAL_COUNT AS busTerminalCount, SUBWAY_STATION_COUNT AS subwayStationCount, BUS_STOP_COUNT AS busStopCount FROM VISITOR_FACILITY_ADMIN_DONG WHERE ADMIN_DONG_CODE = #{adminDongCode} AND BASE_YEAR_QUARTER_CODE = #{yearQuarter}

SELECT MONTHLY_AVG_INCOME_AMOUNT AS monthlyAvgIncomeAmount, INCOME_RANGE_CODE AS incomeRangeCode, TOTAL_EXPENDITURE_AMOUNT AS totalExpenditureAmount, FOOD_EXPENDITURE_AMOUNT AS foodExpenditureAmount, CLOTHING_SHOES_EXPENDITURE_AMOUNT AS clothingShoesExpenditureAmount, HOUSEHOLD_GOODS_EXPENDITURE_AMOUNT AS householdGoodsExpenditureAmount, MEDICAL_EXPENDITURE_AMOUNT AS medicalExpenditureAmount, TRANSPORT_EXPENDITURE_AMOUNT AS transportExpenditureAmount, EDUCATION_EXPENDITURE_AMOUNT AS educationExpenditureAmount, ENTERTAINMENT_EXPENDITURE_AMOUNT AS entertainmentExpenditureAmount, LEISURE_CULTURE_EXPENDITURE_AMOUNT AS leisureCultureExpenditureAmount, ETC_EXPENDITURE_AMOUNT AS etcExpenditureAmount, FOOD_SERVICE_EXPENDITURE_AMOUNT AS foodServiceExpenditureAmount FROM INCOME_CONSUMPTION WHERE ADMIN_DONG_CODE = #{adminDongCode} AND BASE_YEAR_QUARTER_CODE = #{yearQuarter}

SELECT COMMERCIAL_CHANGE_INDICATOR_CODE AS commercialChangeIndicatorCode, COMMERCIAL_CHANGE_INDICATOR_NAME AS commercialChangeIndicatorName, OPERATING_BUSINESS_MONTH_AVG AS operatingBusinessMonthAvg, CLOSED_BUSINESS_MONTH_AVG AS closedBusinessMonthAvg, SEOUL_OPERATING_BUSINESS_MONTH_AVG AS seoulOperatingBusinessMonthAvg, SEOUL_CLOSED_BUSINESS_MONTH_AVG AS seoulClosedBusinessMonthAvg FROM COMMERCIAL_CHANGE_INDICATOR WHERE ADMIN_DONG_CODE = #{adminDongCode} AND BASE_YEAR_QUARTER_CODE = #{yearQuarter}
